draft_key_information_units.information: Eleving Group achieved all-time best financial performance in 2024 with EUR 29.6 mln net profit (21% YoY increase), EUR 216.6 mln revenue (+15% YoY), EUR 89.8 mln EBITDA (+10% YoY), and EUR 371.2 mln net loan portfolio (+16% YoY).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report '2024 at a glance'; Consolidated statements of profit and loss; CEO keynote

draft_key_information_units.information: Key year-over-year improvements included a 29.3% capitalization ratio (vs 26.1% in 2023), 2.4 interest coverage ratio (vs 2.3), and reduced net leverage to 3.3x (from 3.7x).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report financial highlights; Note 48 Alternative Performance Measures

draft_key_information_units.information: Major performance drivers were organic growth in Europe/Africa, successful integration of Sub-Saharan operations (tripling regional portfolio), digital transformation (doubled applications, new self-service platform), and enhanced risk management improving portfolio quality.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO keynote; Management report operations section

draft_key_information_units.information: Business segments showed vehicle finance (67% of portfolio: 45% traditional, 20% flexible/subscription) and consumer finance (33%: Kredo, Tigo, etc.), with key growth in East Africa (e-motorcycles), Romania, Uganda, and Albania offsetting exits from Balkan/Belarus.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report segments; Sustainability statement portfolio balance

draft_key_information_units.information: Capital structure transformed via October 2024 IPO raising EUR 29.0 mln equity (largest in Nasdaq Riga history), used to repay subordinated bonds and high-cost Mintos loans, while expanding local currency funding (Kenya +30%, Botswana notes).

Strategic priorities include deepening existing markets, broadening product portfolio (e.g., electric motorcycle financing surpassing 2025 targets), geographic expansion, and developing ESG strategy for 2026-2031 with climate neutrality targets for HQ operations.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Business outlook; Sustainability framework; CEO keynote

draft_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting period events include March 2025 senior secured bond tap (EUR 40 mln at reduced yield) and expected North Macedonia tax refund of EUR 1.151 mln from 2023 solidarity tax, both impacting 2025 liquidity.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after balance sheet date section

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover headline metrics (D1), YoY changes and capital structure (D2, D5), explicitly stated drivers (D3) and segment developments (D4), major strategic moves (D6), and material post-period events (D7). Excluded routine governance/remuneration (avoided boilerplate) and ensured each unit represents independently omittable themes without duplication. Prioritized HIGH importance for core performance, drivers, and strategy per evaluation instructions.
